title: Why the 4% Withdrawal Rule Can Hurt Your Portfolio

scenes.text: Withdrawing 4% annually could deplete a $1M nest egg in 30 years.
Everyone swears 4% is safe for any retirement plan.
scenes.label: 4% Is Always Safe

scenes.text: Recent studies show a 4% rule is unsafe when bond yields hit 6% or higher, leading to a 50% risk of depletion.
scenes.label: Higher Yields Increase Risk

scenes.text: Adjust withdrawals to match current market yields.
scenes.label: Yield‑Based Withdrawals

scenes.text: Follow if you're done staying broke.

description: The 4% rule might sound safe, but it can drain your savings if bond yields rise. Adjust your withdrawals based on real‑time market data to protect your nest egg. Follow for smart retirement strategies.
